tasks.summary: Fix count_words and top_words in a tiny library so they follow README.md; the agent must read, edit, run the failing tests and pass them.
Fix a byte-size formatter that prints 1024 as '1024 B' and gets unit boundaries wrong.
Fix an 'Open recent' list that duplicates files differing in case or slash style and trims too little when the capacity shrinks (two interacting bugs).
Add a Markdown renderer (alignment, escaping, minimum widths) to a small table library.
Write a test suite for a shop shipping-fee calculator that catches seeded bugs.
Fix CsvWriter: quote doubling instead of backslashes, CRLF row endings, and quoting of line breaks and edge spaces.
Fix invoice numbering: the fiscal year must start on 1 July and Next must continue after the highest number, not the count.
Add Checkout.Total: per-line volume discounts, then a coupon (SAVE5, TENOFF) with half-up cent rounding.
Write an xunit suite for a one-day room booking class that catches seeded bugs.
Fix backoff.Delay: the first retry waits base, and large attempts must not overflow.
Fix logfmt.Parse: escaped quotes/backslashes in quoted values and a key without value at the end of the line.
Add cfgdiff.Diff: compare two nested configs and list added, removed and changed paths.
Write a Go test suite for a warehouse stock model (reserve/release/ship) that catches seeded bugs.
Fix Isbn: ISBN-10 with an X check digit (any case) is rejected, and toIsbn13 emits 10 as a check digit instead of 0.
Fix Version.compareTo: a release must beat its prerelease, numeric prerelease identifiers compare as numbers, more identifiers win on a shared prefix.
Add WordStats.top(text, n, stopWords): most frequent words, stop words skipped, ties alphabetical.
Write a JUnit suite for a bounded priority job queue (submit/next/peek/cancel/bump/position) that catches seeded bugs.
Fix parse_duration so millisecond parts (250ms, 2m500ms) are not read as minutes.
Fix prorated_charge: the start day must count and halves must round up.
Add render_changelog, which groups commit lines into ordered Markdown sections.
Write a unittest suite for a meeting-room booking calendar that catches seeded bugs.
Fix a duration parser that treats the millisecond unit as minutes.
Fix a token-bucket rate limiter whose refill bookkeeping loses partial intervals and ignores the capacity.
Implement unique_slug (length-limited, collision-free URL slugs) next to an existing slugify.
Write an integration test suite for a shipping price calculator that catches seeded bugs.
Fix pageButtons: a total equal to maxButtons must show all pages and the last-pages layout must start at the right page.
Fix splitBill: leftover cents must go to the largest fractional parts, ties to the earlier person.
Add wrapText(text, width) to text.ts: greedy wrapping, paragraphs kept, over-long words cut.
Write a node:test suite for an LRU cache that catches seeded bugs.
CLI11: ignore_underscore() also ignores letter case in validators, option names and subcommands; find and fix the shared cause.
CLI11: add a public validator CLI::MultipleOf(divisor) with exact rules, docs in README and the book, and own tests.
Cronos: 'last day of February' jobs fire a day early in leap years such as 2000; the cause sits in the calendar helper, not in the cron expression class.
Cronos: add CronExpression.IsMatch for a UTC DateTime and for a DateTimeOffset in a time zone, exact rules, README section, XML docs and own tests.
Fix go-humanize: the *WithDigits functions (SIWithDigits, CommafWithDigits, FtoaWithDigits) cut one decimal too many.
Add humanize.Rate and humanize.IRate: bytes per duration as a throughput string, exact integer math, with docs and own tests.
Fix picocli: option names that start with a digit or underscore (-1, --3d, --_x) lose their prefix-stripped form, which breaks description keys, findOption/hasMatchedOption and help ordering.
Add a built-in picocli type converter for java.util.Locale (BCP 47 tags, '_' accepted, strict, no language-less tags), with README docs and own tests.
tenacity: stop_before_delay lets a retry through that would run past its limit (regression in the retry loop, not in the stop module).
tenacity: add a public stop condition stop_before_idle (limit on total sleeping time), with docs and tests.
clap_lex: a long flag with an empty value (`--name=`) is parsed as having no value; the cause sits in another module than the symptom.
clap_lex: add OsStrExt::rsplit_once and ParsedArg::to_long_rsplit (split at the last match), with docs and tests.
rfc6902: createPatch writes wrong paths for object keys containing a slash (regression in the JSON Pointer escaping, not in the diff code).
rfc6902: add touchedPaths(patch), the minimal sorted list of JSON Pointer paths a patch changes, with README section and own tests.
Fix a backup script: quoting, exit codes, pipefail, rotation by name, dry run.
Add Get-StaleAccount to a PowerShell 7 module: validation, pipeline input, exact output objects and errors.
Fix a small OpenTofu config: validation, for_each keys, secret handling and a motd count condition.
Add a reusable OpenTofu module that renders a service config file, with validation, and use it twice.
Complete an Ansible role that turns a container into a small, idempotent nginx web host.
Fix a Bash installer and a systemd unit for a heartbeat daemon: dedicated user, restart policy, quoting, idempotent install, clean systemd-analyze verify.
Fix a Packer docker template: provisioner order, a version that never reaches the image, file permissions, root user, tags.
OpenTofu docker provider: a reusable nginx stack module (network, keyed containers, rendered config) used twice as blue and green.
A multi-role Ansible project that worked last month now changes things on every run and leaves one web host misconfigured; find and fix the causes without hiding failures or changes.

An SSH jump-host lab (client, bastion, two app hosts as docker containers) is broken in several places; fix the config and the setup script until the README's end state holds, without weakening any security setting.

Troubleshoot a flapping service under a deterministic tick-driven supervisor in a container: health path, backgrounded start, stale pid file, root and unwritable log dir, short start grace, no log rotation.
OpenTofu state refactor: flat count-based root with applied state into a for_each module plus a rename, using moved blocks, with zero create/destroy and unchanged random values.

log.text: Smarter screening: attempt 3 is skipped when attempts 1 and 2 agree (the 2-of-3 verdict cannot change), and finalists later get fresh, complete runs. Up to a third fewer attempts, and the energy with them.

The sysadmin track is built: 12 tasks in Bash, PowerShell, OpenTofu, Ansible, Packer and SSH, against containers in the sandbox, never a real cloud. S3 checks also catch fixes that 'work' by weakening security (passwords back on, StrictHostKeyChecking off, chmod 777) or by hiding failures.

L3 is ready: 8 fresh tasks on concurrency, lifecycle, cancellation and compatibility in real projects, every one proven deterministic 20 times in a row. Their hashes are published below before any model has run them.

All 42 coding tasks are built and proven: 28 at L1 and 14 at L2, in 7 languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, C++, Rust, Go). L2 uses real open-source projects: tenacity, CLI11, clap_lex, rfc6902, go-humanize, picocli, Cronos.
CPU package power is measured now. Models that run their experts on the CPU draw as much from the CPU as from the GPU (about 160 W): about 25 Wh per solved L1 task for Qwen3-Coder-30B.
Strata IQ2_XS (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, 64 GB, 2-bit) solves all 72 L1 attempts with its maker's sampling settings.

Sampling matters: neither agent sends settings, so Strata decoded greedy and Pi looped on 2 'write tests' tasks. A repetition penalty ended the loops but not the misses (70/72 either way). The makers' settings scored 72/72. All main results now use each maker's settings.

The token-bucket task is the hardest L1 task: 8 of 9 misses implement the README rule only on the path where tokens were earned. Every wrong fix passes the visible tests, so only reading the spec finds it.
First results: L0 qualification passed by Pi and OpenCode on Strata Coder IQ1_M. Pi reads about a third of OpenCode's tokens.
